Use the supplied query-property assessment only as an uncertain physicochemical prior. It is not experimental evidence or a label prediction. Its structure contains an ionizable piperidine and several polar functionalities but is not an obvious extreme BBB non-penetrant. The experimental result therefore outweighs any more favorable physicochemical intuition: whatever mechanism limits its CNS exposure is real. Because the transfer score is high and the query shares relevant ionization and heteroatom features, that measured phenotype has strong implications for the query.
